name: DWH #SITE Projection Profile
purpose: provide the canonical SiteTree runtime projection from DWH website relations
authorityFlow: derived navigation, breadcrumbs, sitemap, routing and composition
rules: site.json is not a canonical authority
JSON may be used as a transport serialization without becoming identity
WebEngine validates the received SiteTree projection before use
navigation and other hierarchy views remain derived from the received SiteTree projection
WebEngine must not infer DWH relations or query DWH storage internals
